backtest.disclaimer: HEM+ predicts next-year wOBA out of sample. PA, SB and the slash line are context: HEM+ is rate skill, not volume or speed.

multiyear.note: 3-year HEM+ is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from hem_plus_multiyear_eval.json, as of generated_at, not this board's as_of. Hitters who joined the pool since have no value.

wrc_plus.note: wRC+ is MLB's PUBLISHED value, read verbatim from the bulk season-total sabermetrics feed and joined by MLBAM id; this site derives none (HEM+ is its own offense index). A season total, never a stint, so a traded hitter reads one line. Shown at 100+ PA only: unlike HEM+ it is unshrunk.

war_rate.note: 100 + 10z of eWAR per PA over hitters with 50+ PA: 10 points = 1 pool SD, not the HEM+/REM+/SEM+ ratio scale. eWAR: Baseball-Reference run frame, pitching re-priced on FIP, fielding unchanged pending SDR; position players match bWAR except in seasons they also pitched. No shrink, no clamp; blank under 100 PA.
war_rate.adj_note: war_pa_plus_adj shrinks the rate toward the pool rate by sample size (K = pool median PA = 297) and re-standardises on the SHRUNK pool. A readability aid for thin samples, not a forward claim: ship gate G2 failed on every pool, and a post-hoc volume control puts most of the shrink gain down to volume. Does NOT reproduce war/pa on the row.

ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar.json rebuilds its live season nightly; completed seasons are frozen byte for byte and re-priced only by a hand build with the runbook cascade.

multiyear_war_rate.note: The 3-year column is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from war_rate_plus_multiyear_eval.json, as of generated_at, not this board's as_of. Hitters who joined the pool since have no value.

keys.split: teams[].orders.vr / teams[].orders.vl - the hand-labelled orders. Trust the LABELS only when bat_side.available is true.
keys.neutral: teams[].order_no_platoon - present ONLY when the split was not applied. The one constructed nine, under a name that claims nothing about handedness.
keys.flag: teams[].platoon_applied - false means render ONE lineup and say the split is unavailable; do not offer a vs-LHP / vs-RHP toggle.

bat_side.note: Bat side (L/R/S) drives the vs-LHP / vs-RHP order: the platoon term and the handedness stagger both read it.

platoon_splits.source: StatsAPI statSplits sitCodes vl/vr, playerPool=All, two bulk calls; per-hand HEM+ scored on the same season pool anchor

lineup_cards.display_only: bench per-hand fields, slot_meta, platoon_options and regulars_out are display siblings of teams[].orders; no betting or vintage reader may use them

team_basis.label: hitting 2026
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

roster_filter.basis: StatsAPI rosterType=active (26-man), so an optioned or injured player drops
roster_filter.scope: the constructed orders, lineup and bench ONLY. Offense+ and every other aggregate stay on the full season pool: HEM+ over PA already taken stands whether or not the player is hurt now, and Offense+ feeds betting_model and the leaderboard vintages behind the 600-game clock.
roster_filter.on_failure: a failed roster fetch filters NOTHING rather than blanking the charts; a player whose mlbam cannot be read is kept

team_war.note: team_war is the sum of the club's board rows' bat eWAR, summed UNROUNDED and rounded once; team_war_n is the rows summed, a row whose own eWAR cell is withheld for a zero denominator included. A club with no covered row carries no value. Same club basis as the Team column (see team_basis).
